overview_description.description:
In many conventional hygiene products found traces of synthetic fabrics such as bleach, chemical residues, perfume, cellulose, plastic, chlorine, superabsorbents and petrochemicals.These can have negative effects on the female body as delicate vaginal mucosa it easy to record them.Therefore, many women experience allergic reactions such as itching and pain associated with the use of hygiene products. 

The use of organic cotton can help reduce and prevent the risk of irritation and allergies.
At Aluna we want to make it easy for you to choose hygiene products produced with organic cotton. Therefore, we offer allergy-friendly products that can help to reduce and prevent the risk of irritations, allergies and infections.
